note: Built-in scenarios: the playground chips, the change-impact presets and the Ask the ledger examples. The UI loads this file; replay mode has recorded model outputs for exactly these (python -m asof.replay record). The customer chat page (chat.html) uses the chat bookings: the booking date is what the booking system would send as the as-of date. The reviews are suggested specialist replies for two of the demo's held drafts (asof.demo.HELD_DRAFTS), for the specialist inbox.

presets.label: Pet fee to $125 from 1 Dec 2026
presets.text: Small cats and dogs may travel in the cabin if the pet and its carrier together weigh no more than 8 kg. The pet fee is $125 each way.
presets.note: Pet fee rises to $125 from 1 December 2026.

presets.label: Bereavement window to 60 days from 1 Jan 2027
presets.text: Bereavement fares may be requested before travel or retroactively. A retroactive request must be submitted within 60 days of the date the original ticket was issued, together with the documentation listed in clause BRV-003. Approved retroactive requests are refunded the fare difference to the original form of payment.

presets.label: First bag to $45 from 1 Jan 2027
presets.text: The first checked bag costs $45 each way on Economy fares.

presets.label: Bank: overdraft fee to $20 from 1 Jan 2027
presets.text: An overdraft fee of $20 is charged for each item we pay when the account does not have enough available funds.
presets.note: Overdraft fee falls to $20 from 1 January 2027.

reviews.question: Can my 12-year-old fly alone to her grandmother's funeral?
reviews.reply: We do not offer an escort service for children flying alone, so a 12-year-old needs to travel with an adult.
reviews.note: No clause covers unaccompanied minors. Operations confirmed Aurelia Air has no escort service.

reviews.question: My father died last week and I fly tomorrow. Can I still get the bereavement fare?
reviews.reply: Yes, as long as you ask before you fly: bereavement fares must be requested before travel begins.
